_comment: vendor/halide/refa/sensors_config.json - multihal handle map (S21 runbook companion, S38). Installed to /vendor/etc/sensors_config.json. Every handle's maxDelayUs/fifoReservedEventCount match measured rows in sensors/<sku>/inventory.md + power.md (S32); config claims without measurement carry measured:false (amber) and refuse direct-report even on YES rows.

handles.power_note: wake accel for step-detect; see sensors power.md

invariants: direct grows only for accel/gyro at allowlisted rates; any other direct-register counts as P1 + missing threat-note
wake sensors attributed per handle in wakeup_sources; unnamed sensor wakes = misclassified non-wake, P1
dropped-batch stays 0 at max-batch (shake-table 100Hz 60s); drops mean watermark IRQ late
